Name: Protector of the Valley achievement
Author: agdanightfall
Description:
All you need to do is go to the caves and kill one slime to finish and obtain the achievement. File works for Steam and Xbox Game Pass PC (shared game saves).
Unzip to ...\AppData\Roaming\StardewValley\Saves and load game as usual. Load "Tom" save game.
